Definition: from G846 and G714; self-complacent, i.e. contented:--content.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says he has learned, in whatsoever state he is, therewith to be content, and the word means self-sufficient in the Christian sense, satisfied because Christ supplies. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe contentment is learned, not born, and Paul learned it in need and in plenty alike.
